scripts.title: Easy2Use AutoFarm
scripts.features:
What is this AutoFarm?

This is an easy to use autofarm for the Game "Gym League". You can customize and toggle everything in it. You can even setup an webhook environment that logs your leaderstats every 5 minutes and sends it into your server.

What do I need to do?

Enable the AutoFarm and AntiAfk in the GUI and sit on a bench, or any station. It will automatically click and if your stamina is low it will wait until its full again. You can even customize when it stops.

How much money can I make

It depends but its really fast. You can look on the webhooks how much money you make every 5 minutes.

Features:

- AutoFarm
- AntiAfk
- Stamina Slider
- Webhook Logger
